item.title: Bellman-Ford Algorithm
item.description: The Bellman-Ford Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the length of the shortest path from a vertex s to every vertex in a directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights and no negative cycles in \mathcal{O}(|V||E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|V|) space.

item.title: Borůvka's Algorithm
item.description: Borůvka’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the weight of the minimum spanning tree of a connected undirected graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|E|\log|V|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Extended Chinese Remainder Theorem
item.description: The Extended Chinese Remainder Theorem is an algorithm that checks if \exists x\in\Z,x\equiv a_0\pmod{m_0}\land x\equiv a_1\pmod{m_1} and finds such an integer x if there exists for integers a_0,a_1 and postive integers m_0,m_1 in \mathcal{O}(\log m_0+\log m_1) time and \mathcal{O}(\log m_0+\log m_1...

item.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
item.description: Dijkstra’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the length of the shortest path from a vertex s to every vertex in a directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with non-negative edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|V|^2+|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|V|+|E|) space, or \mathcal{O}((|V|+|E|)\log|E|) time and \mathcal...

item.title: Euler's Sieve
item.description: Euler’s Sieve is an algorithm that finds the primes in 2,3,\dots,n in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Floyd-Warshall Algorithm
item.description: The Floyd-Warshall Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the length of the shortest path between every pair of vertices in a directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights and no negative cycles in \mathcal{O}(|V|^3+|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|V|^2) space.

item.title: Hierholzer's Algorithm
item.description: Hierholzer’s Algorithm is an algorithm that finds an Eulerian circuit in a weakly connected directed graph G=\langle V,E\rangle, where the in-degree of each vertex equals its out-degree, in \mathcal{O}(|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Johnson's Algorithm
